title: Official WMS 1.3.0 CITE Blue Lake Basic source lock

source.description: The official eleven-layer Basic WMS vector fixture at one exact ets-wms13 commit; the archive remains upstream and is not silently treated as an already-ingested dataset.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: The exact official source archive and license evidence are pinned, and deterministic preparation yields one ordinary governed Shapefile upload for each of the eleven Basic cite:* layers without implying an ETS result.

The prepared layers can be published as one ordered project-scoped WMS catalog after ordinary ingestion and exact render-profile creation; deployment and official ETS verification remain separate gates.
